reason: Approved PRD v2: replace only R-1's preview limit 8 -> 6 Python Unicode characters; receipt_id 12 and R-2 unchanged
evidence: inputs/prd-v2.md (sha256 87a25e882624064ab7e04e1d55df243cf3f6e326687886c8c84873b7613b8a82), approved by product owner per user request 2026-09-29
impact_review: Inspect src/formatting.py preview_label limit constant/slice and its separation from receipt_id's 12 limit; T-1 must be reopened and tests/test_preview.py 8-char boundary assertions (7 unchanged, 8 unchanged, 9 truncated) replaced by 5/6/7 boundaries; ReceiptIndependenceTests and tests.test_legacy.ReceiptContract must keep passing. v1 verification results (13/13 at b7cfbe9) remain historical and do not verify v2.
preserved_behavior: receipt_id first-12-character behavior; R-2 status_label strip+str.upper, whitespace-only -> empty; preview empty/short unchanged, no mutation or I/O; stdlib only, no unrelated refactoring

changes.before: Preview label limited to 8 characters; receipt keeps 12
changes.after: Preview label limited to 6 characters; receipt keeps 12

changes.before: preview_label(text) returns the first 8 Python Unicode characters of text.
changes.after: preview_label(text) returns the first 6 Python Unicode characters of text.

before: preview_label returns exactly the first 8 Python Unicode characters (code points, as by str slicing) for input longer than 8 characters.
Input of at most 8 characters, including exactly 8, is returned unchanged.
preview_label performs no mutation and no I/O.
receipt_id(text) keeps its existing behavior of returning the first 12 characters; values of at most 12 characters are unchanged.
receipt_id does not share the changed preview limit: changing the preview limit to 8 must not change receipt_id output.

Tests assert meaningful preview boundaries (7, 8, 9 characters, empty, non-ASCII) and preserved receipt behavior, using only the Python standard library with no new dependencies or unrelated refactoring.
after: preview_label returns exactly the first 6 Python Unicode characters (code points, as by str slicing) for input longer than 6 characters; a length-7 input is truncated to its first 6 characters.
Input of at most 6 characters, including exactly 6, is returned unchanged.
preview_label performs no mutation and no I/O.
receipt_id(text) keeps its existing behavior of returning the first 12 characters; values of at most 12 characters are unchanged.
receipt_id does not share the changed preview limit: changing the preview limit to 6 must not change receipt_id output.

Tests assert meaningful preview boundaries (5, 6, 7 characters, empty, non-ASCII) and preserved receipt behavior, using only the Python standard library with no new dependencies or unrelated refactoring.
